info.bio:
Justin Drew Bieber Mallette (nacido el 1 de marzo de 1994 en Ontario, Canadá) es un cantante R&B y pop. También toca la trompeta, la guitarra, el piano y la batería. 
Con 12 años ya se presentaba a concursos de canto y pronto comenzó a subir videos a You tube donde se hizo muy famoso por hacer covers de canciones de artistas como Usher, Stevie Wonder, Ne-Yo, Justin Timberlake y Michael Jackson.

podcast.body: Justin Bieber sold his music catalog to the Hypnosis Song Fund for $200 million in early 2023. This was noted as Merck Mercuriatis's biggest acquisition to that point. His catalog's value is also bolstered by his large streaming audience, with 80 million monthly listeners on Spotify compared to Bruce Springsteen's 17 million. "Justin Bieber $200 million." "Merck's biggest acquisition to this point has been Justin Bieber's catalog. This happened in early 2023, for which Bieber was paid $200 million." "Justin Bieber's fans have 60 years or 70 years in front of them as opposed to 30 years in front of them. That makes sense. And Bruce Springsteen has about 17 million monthly followers, monthly listeners on Spotify versus Justin Bieber's 80 million monthly listeners."
